text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: El Condor Pasa and I are on our way back from a day out, when…

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: It's already dark. I guess we took it a little too easy today.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: We've got an early day tomorrow too, Trainer. Let's call it as soon as we get ba—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Rayos!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I totally forgot I have homework due tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: On top of that, I forgot the handout in the classroom!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: This is the third time I've forgotten my homework!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: My teacher said I'll have to write an extra report if I forget again! Ughhh!
choice_data_list: Let's go get the handout right now.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Really?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Thank you! Thank youuu! Let's go get it right away!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Hm… The lights are on, but it's still dark.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: N-n-no way! I've got my mask on, so there's nothin' to be afraid of!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I don't believe in ghosts or anything! It's just…

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I watched a horror movie last night with Grass and everyone, and…

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: There was an old nobleman attacking people with an axe to get revenge.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: And it was set at a school at night… Ugh, I'd be fine if it was just a ghost!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Well, it wouldn't be a big deal using all my techniques on a ghost!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: But I can't just go all out on an amateur with my wrestling moves!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: So basically, I can't fight! Maybe it'd be okay if we were talking about a strong Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I don't quite understand her logic, but I don't ask any more questions.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Well, we can't just sit around here. Let's get to the classroom!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Ugh… It's so dark…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The lights along the hall are all out.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I-I'm El Condor Pasa… the strongest racer…

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I'm not afraid of anything!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: For not being afraid of anything, she seems to be looking around pretty frantically.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Th-the old scaredy-cat El is gone!
choice_data_list: You're the world's strongest and the world's fastest!
Look out behind you! He's got an axe!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Ah! Trainer!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Th-that's right! Fastest in the world, with nerves of steel, and quick as lightning!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: The name's El Condor Pasaaa!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: No one can keep up, no matter who they are!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: If things get hairy, I can definitely escape. Even if I have to carry you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Thanks, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She seems full of motivation now. El Condor Pasa gets her papers and we leave without any trouble.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Madre mía! Is it the old nobleman?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I'm not afraid! Nooot at all! Not even of old noblemen with axes!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I'm El, the world's strongest racer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: El Condor Pasa runs away at breakneck speed, but…

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Where am I? Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In her panic, she ends up getting lost somewhere in the school.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A while later, she finds her way back…

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I'm so tired… of running… I'm not even scared anymore…

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Please, don't disappear without saying anything again!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rather than remind her that she's the one who ran off, I comfort El Condor Pasa.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the plus side, it seems like the run turned out to be a good bit of training.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Afterward, an exhausted El Condor Pasa manages to finish her homework and avoids having to write an extra report.
